collectionNotes.eugene-deloncle: Fascist: he led the Cagoule (fr: "organisation terroriste fasciste") and the fascist MSR party.
collectionNotes.marcel-deat: Fascist: he founded and led the RNP ("parti politique français fasciste"). Not in non-bolshevik-socialist: his SFIO period is a documented membership, but the card is defined by the later fascist party. Add it only if the collection is meant to cover a period like that.
collectionNotes.philippe-henriot: Fascist through his Milice membership. Conservative because he was vice-president of the Republican Federation ("un parti conservateur"), which matches the conservative-party criterion.
collectionNotes.robert-brasillach: Fascist is a judgement call: he openly called himself a fascist (fr: "assume avoir été, et être encore, fasciste"), but no fascist party membership is documented, and the collection intro asks for members and leaders. Drop it if that rule is applied strictly.
